scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/brumacafe/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/brumacafe
  set jcr:title{String} to "Bruma Cafe"
end
create service user brumacafe-contact-service with path system/cq:services/brumacafe

set ACL for brumacafe-contact-service
  allow jcr:read,rep:write,jcr:versionManagement,jcr:modifyAccessControl on /var/brumacafe
end
